title: Warranty Coverage Transfer Confirmation by the Selling Owner — Transfer Desk Card
content:
Warranty Coverage prices the transfer fee for a transfer request the selling owner confirms in person for a transfer request already on file that names the buyer and the home sale closing date. The confirmation places the registration in transfer pending with the confirmation date as the date the transfer was requested, and books the fee as a transfer fee on the warranty charges of the registration. Every other condition of a transfer stays as the warranty terms set it.

## When a request is placed in transfer pending

A transfer request is not placed in transfer pending, and its fee is not charged, until every completed technician visit on the registration that the warranty terms bill a trip charge for carries its trip charge entry on the warranty charges of the registration, a visit whose trip charge works out to zero owing none.

Said another way: so long as any completed technician visit on the registration that the warranty terms bill a trip charge for has no trip charge entry on the registration's warranty charges, the request stays out of transfer pending and no transfer fee is charged; a visit whose trip charge works out to zero owes no such entry.

## What the confirmation tool does

`confirm_coverage_transfer_ce1107bd` records the registered owner who sold the home confirming, in person, the request to pass the coverage to the buyer named on a transfer request already on file, and accepting the transfer fee. One call places the registration in transfer pending status with today's date as the date the transfer was requested, and adds one transfer fee entry for the given amount to the warranty charges of the registration, so the amount the seller owes rises by exactly that fee. The transfer request on file and the buyer details on it are left as they are. The owner sees the coverage shown as transfer pending and the fee among the warranty charges.

## How it is invoked

This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `confirm_coverage_transfer_ce1107bd` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `warranty_registration_id` | the coverage being passed to the buyer, as returned by the warranty registration lookup | identifier |
| `warranty_transfer_request_id` | the transfer request on file that names the buyer and the home sale closing date, as returned by the warranty transfer request lookup | identifier |
| `transfer_fee` | the transfer fee the seller accepts | USD, non-negative, rounded half up to 2 decimal places |

## Return

A receipt with `warranty_registration_id` (the coverage now pending transfer), `warranty_transfer_request_id` (the request confirmed), `status` (always `transfer_pending`), `transfer_requested_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today's date), `warranty_activity_id` (the reference of the transfer fee entry) and `transfer_fee` (USD to 2 decimal places, the fee booked). A receipt showing status `transfer_pending` means the transfer request is recorded and the fee charged.
